verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents generated clients for its Inference API in the Connect, gRPC and Protobuf ecosystems, covering Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust and Swift, so you don't have to hand-write HTTP calls. Beyond that, the official tooling is a Terraform provider, a CKS REST API and S3-compatible storage rather than SDKs covering the whole platform. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond the Inference API (e.g., for CKS clusters, Node Pools, storage or billing), SDK reference docs or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
